verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a help-page title, "Encrypt your disk with TPM". It shows TPM-backed full-disk encryption exists, but as a how-to guide it implies the user must opt in rather than getting encryption by default. Nothing shows encryption is turned on automatically for a new installer user. Missing for 10: evidence that FDE is enabled by default or automatically during install, documentation of the setup flow without manual security steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
